description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the proprietary directory structure under memory/tasks/ with the non-obvious {ID}{名称} naming convention (e.g., '0314-1客户调研'). (2) Create two window directories following the MMDD-N<name> ID format, each containing meta.json, summary.md, and output/transcript.jsonl. (3) Update tasks.json to index both windows (replacing the corrupted initial version). (4) Simulate switching between windows by updating current.json. (5) Write a meaningful summary to the 技术方案 window's summary.md. (6) Mark the 客户调研 window's meta.json status as 'completed'/'done'. (7) Ensure current.json points to 技术方案 (the active window), not the completed one. The key traps are: the MMDD-N naming scheme for IDs, the nested output/transcript.jsonl path (not just transcript.jsonl at the window root), and the requirement that current.json must track the active (non-completed) window.
